message: New index orders_user_id_idx on existing table orders (user_id) (postgres). A non-CONCURRENT CREATE INDEX takes a SHARE lock that blocks writes for the duration of the build.
mitigation: Use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (and DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY for rollback) in postgres.

message: New FK orders_user_id_fkey on existing table orders (postgres). Adding a FK validates all existing rows under SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock.
mitigation: Use ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID, then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in a separate transaction.
